reference.shortdesc: This API request includes the following header parameters.

section.p: This API request includes the following header parameters.
The header parameters provide instructions to the API on handling the request, such as authentication and compressing responses over 1KB.

row.entry: Authenticates API requests. Provide a valid bearer token in the HTTP header. This bearer token can be obtained from the OAuth bearer token request.

Compresses responses. Responses over 1KB in size will automatically be compressed. The client must be capable of receiving and decompressing the response. Warning: The header is not set; responses greater than 1 KB will fail.

gzip: Compression format using the Lempel-Ziv coding (LZ77), with a 32-bit CRC. deflate: Compression format using the zlib structure and deflate compression algorithm. br: Compression format using the Brotli algorithm.
